result.title: Towards Portable Specification of the Agent Harness
result.summary: Large language models act only through the infrastructure that surrounds them. That infrastructure, the harness, determines what a model can accomplish and how it fails, yet it has no settled definition. To address this gap, we decompose the harness into eight functional components that can be specified and compared across systems, and we propose a portable specification framework that records which model ran in which harness. The record is needed because different harness configurations can yield several-fold differences in reported scores for the same model, and because much of an agent's attack surface lies in its harness. Existing model cards and agent cards provide release and operational information, but do not establish the sequence of effective configurations within a run. Harnesses can change between releases and between runs, and, where agents edit their own tools and configuration, within a run. Enacted AI laws contain documentation duties relevant to covered systems, subject to their respective scopes and application dates, but do not prescribe the common harness record proposed here. Therefore, the harness has to be explicitly described and specified as a versioned part of the system.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出智能体实际依赖外围的「harness」基础设施，将其拆为八个功能组件，并提出可移植的规格框架，记录某次运行中模型与 harness 的具体配置组合，理由是同模型在不同配置下报告分数可相差数倍，且攻击面多集中于 harness。
AI.relevance_reason: THINK/LOOK/STOP 的预算、工具调用与推理脚手架本身即类似 harness 配置，该文的版本化配置记录思路可供核查：如何在报告中固定推理期设置，避免把脚手架差异误读为 latent 推理方法的收益；但材料不涉及视觉或 latent 表示。
